subject: Draft MAP & next steps — HarborTech (pilot scope + dependencies)
messages:
From: Rafael Mendes <rafael.mendes@redwoodinference.com>
To: Jessica Kim <jessica.kim@harbortech.com>, Mark Sullivan <mark.sullivan@harbortech.com>
Cc: Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Mon, 3 May 2027 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Draft MAP & next steps — HarborTech (pilot scope + dependencies)

Hi Jessica / Mark —

Thanks again for the discovery call this morning. Per our conversation I put together a short Mutual Action Plan (MAP) draft that captures the pilot scope, proposed milestones, owners, target close date, and the dependencies we discussed. Please find the draft attached (HarborTech_MAP_v0.2.xlsx) along with a light SOW outline so procurement has context.

High-level summary (please confirm):
- Objective: 6-week pilot to validate inference latency and cost for HarborTech's Summarize API (timeline: 6/1/27 start)
- Target close (enterprise contract): 2027-07-15
- Key milestones:
  1) Pilot kickoff — Redwood to provision pilot env (owner: Rafael) — target 2027-06-01
  2) Data ingest & sample traffic — HarborTech to provide sample payloads, access patterns (owner: HarborTech) — target 2027-06-07
  3) Performance tuning & initial eval — Redwood runtime optimizations + report (owner: Redwood eng/ops) — target 2027-06-14
  4) Business review & contract negotiation — stakeholders (owner: both) — target 2027-07-01
- Dependencies: SOC 2 evidence (HarborTech requested), network egress allowlist (HarborTech), sample payloads and success criteria (joint)
- Commercial note: proposed pilot is complimentary; procurement will review SOW and T&C for enterprise commit if pilot is successful.

A few asks from your side to keep timeline:
1) Can Mark share the security questionnaire / SOC 2 scope to help us prepare answers by 05/07?
2) Please confirm the list of sample datasets (or a point person) for data ingest.
3) If the 07/15 enterprise target is aggressive, let me know preferred close window.

I've cc'd Monica (CS lead) to help with the onboarding checklist. If this looks good I'll upload v0.3 with the changes and a short one-page rollout plan.

Attachments: HarborTech_MAP_v0.2.xlsx (MAP draft), HarborTech_SOW_outline.docx

Thanks —
Rafael Mendes
Account Executive | Redwood Inference
rafael.mendes@redwoodinference.com | (415) 555-0198

From: Jessica Kim <jessica.kim@harbortech.com>
To: Rafael Mendes <rafael.mendes@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: Mark Sullivan <mark.sullivan@harbortech.com>, Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Mon, 3 May 2027 11:03:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Draft MAP & next steps — HarborTech (pilot scope + dependencies)

Thanks Rafael — useful summary. A couple of quick items from our side:

- The 6/1 pilot start looks feasible but we need to confirm resource availability; can we shift the pilot kickoff target to 6/3 if needed?
- I'll share the security questionnaire (we have a standard packet) — Mark, can you send that by EOD tomorrow?
- Procurement (procurement@harbortech.com) will want to see the SOW and any proposed T&Cs; please make sure the SOW outline includes a short line on data retention and log access.

Can you also clarify what you mean by “complimentary” pilot (is unlimited usage during the pilot included)? Procurement will flag anything that looks like a trial fee later.

I'll review the MAP and loop back with sample payload owners.

Jessica

From: Rafael Mendes <rafael.mendes@redwoodinference.com>

Cc: Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwoodinference.com>, Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Tue, 4 May 2027 08:41:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Draft MAP & next steps — HarborTech (pilot scope + dependencies)

Thanks Jessica — quick answers inline, and taking Ben on pricing/terms so procurement has continuity.

- Pilot start: shifting kickoff to 2027-06-03 is fine; I'll update targets in v0.3.
- Security packet: Mark — appreciate if you can share HarborTech's questionnaire; we'll return a completed packet and link to our SOC 2 report by 05/07.
- Complimentary pilot: yes — the pilot includes up to 200k tokens/day of usage during the 6-week window at no charge. If your ingestion exceeds that pattern we'll handle it case-by-case and let procurement know. I'll also add a short clause in the SOW outline clarifying data retention and log access (retention: 30 days by default for pilot telemetry).

Action items I own:
- Update MAP to v0.3 (new kickoff date 06/03, include pilot usage cap and SOW clause) — Rafael — due 05/05
- Provide onboarding checklist & access instructions — Monica — due 05/28

Open items for HarborTech:
- Security questionnaire & SOC 2 scope — Mark — due 05/07
- List of sample datasets and point person — Jessica — due 05/10
- Network egress IP allowlist (for pilot infra) — HarborTech infra team — due 05/24

I'll upload v0.3 once I get Mark's questionnaire and Jessica's sample dataset owner. Ben, if procurement wants to discuss commercial terms early I'm happy to intro.

Thanks —
Rafael Mendes
Account Executive | Redwood Inference

Hi all —

Following up with the revised MAP attached (HarborTech_MAP_v0.3.xlsx). This is a short weekly checkpoint to surface outstanding items and confirm owners/timelines so we can hit the updated kickoff on 2027-06-03.

Summary of changes in v0.3:
- Kickoff moved to 2027-06-03; subsequent milestone dates shifted accordingly.
- Pilot usage cap: 200k tokens/day (complimentary during pilot).
- Added SOW clause: pilot telemetry retention 30 days; data handling notes.
- Added a dependency row for network egress allowlist with specific IPs (please see the attachment).

Outstanding actions (current status):
- Security questionnaire (Mark) — STATUS: pending (requested 05/03) — please share the packet or an expected delivery date.
- Sample datasets & owner (Jessica) — STATUS: pending — needed by 05/10 to validate ingest path.
- Network allowlist (HarborTech infra) — STATUS: overdue if not submitted by 05/24 — this blocks provisioning.

Next steps: please reply inline with any edits or confirm that v0.3 is good to go. If we don't hear back, I'll follow up again next Monday with a short call invite.
